description:
Retype the issue ids that domain structs, event bodies and domain functions carry.

## Background

Domain carriers are `Issue.id` and `dependencies` (`crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs:414,427`), `MinimalIssue.id` (`:670`), `MinimalBlockedIssue.id` (`:758`), `GateRunResult.issue_id` (`:947`), the `issue_id` field of the issue-scoped event variants and `DependencyReduced.removed_deps` (`types.rs:1292-1616`), the artifact-plan issue fields (`domain/artifact_plan.rs:290,352`) and `PlanTarget::Container`, `domain/artifact_classifier.rs:223`, `domain/store_divergence.rs:76`, `domain/type_taxonomy.rs`, the container roots of `domain/artifact_inventory.rs:293,315` and `domain/artifact_discovery.rs:537`, `domain/artifact_conformance.rs:44`, the sample events of `EventTag::sample` (`domain/event_catalog.rs:281-282`), and the domain files `event_log.rs`, `projection.rs` and `item.rs`. About 15 functions in `domain/types.rs` take raw ids. Short ids are truncated by length at `domain/types.rs:551,733,795` and `domain/artifact_classifier.rs:1715`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No struct field, enum field or function parameter under `crates/jit/src/domain/` holds an issue id as `String`, `&str` or `Vec<String>`; each uses `IssueId`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Domain short-id methods delegate to `short_id()` on the id, and no domain site truncates an id by length.
- [hard] REQ-03: Serialized issue, gate-run and event JSON is byte-identical before and after.
- [hard] REQ-04: Code in this family, its unit-test modules included, uses issue ids only through `as_str()`, `short_id()`, `Display`, `Debug`, `Clone`, `PartialEq`/`Eq`, `PartialOrd`/`Ord`, `Hash` and serde, so it compiles unchanged once `IssueId` is the validated newtype.

## Notes

`crate::domain::identity::IssueId` is at this point an alias for `String`, and the `IssueIdStaging` trait gives it `short_id()`. Retyping to the alias is compiler-neutral, so this change is checked by its criteria rather than by type errors; a later change replaces the alias with the validated newtype and the compiler then reports any site missed here. Parameters are retyped outside-in: the CLI and server entry points already resolve ids, and callers in this family are retyped before the functions they call in inner layers.
title: Domain types carry issue ids as IssueId
